g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Sock and glove cuff boundaries are sampled once; shared junctions reuse dots. Shirt has one continuous silhouette. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Sock, glove and T-shirt surfaces receive lower grey areas bounded by higher black lines. Exterior finger valleys and shirt neckline stay white unraised. Original painter order retains single visible cuff contacts. No measured height or material shading.
